package main

// The bare-element corpus (RB9-F6 TS port, step 3, review V-Q second pass D5): a second occurrence of a list member that is not a list but one element. encoding/json
// decodes a JsonList (a list, or - failing that - a single value, which is a list of one) into the slice it already holds, and a JsonUnmarshalListWith runs
// unmarshalList first, which accepts a bare value as a list of one: it grows its Value only if the list is longer, and sets Value[0]; unmarshalSingle (which replaces
// the whole list) is reached only when unmarshalList fails. So `"signatures":[A,B],"signatures":C` is [C,B] in Go, and the dupdiff corpus, which wrote lists, an
// empty list, a null and objects as the second occurrence but never a bare element, did not see that the verifier read [C].
//
// EVERY list member of EVERY object path class of the bases (the same sampling as dupdiff: the first sweepK documents of each form that hold the class, the
// genesis-link documents first) is given a second occurrence of its key that is the list's first element or its last, bare, before the list and after it, and the
// first one after it with the key in upper case. A case is a list of byte edits of the base file, judged as every byte corpus is; each shard is its own file,
// bytes-cases-dupbare-<i>.json.gz, consumed by test/s3-bytes-dupbare-<i+1>.test.ts.
//
//	XTS_SHARD=<i>/<n> ./xtsgen -fixtures $S3 -out <dir> dupbare      (XTS_COUNT=1 only counts)

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

func dupBareCases(doc []byte, n objNode) []objCase {
	if n.inArray || n.ms < 0 || n.kind != 'a' {
		return nil
	}
	el := rawElems(doc[n.vs:n.ve])
	if len(el) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	key := string(doc[n.ms:n.vs]) // `"key" :` as spelled, with its colon and spacing
	out := []objCase{
		{"dup-bare-first-element-after", []ByteEdit{{n.ve, 0, ins("," + key + el[0])}}},
		{"dup-bare-first-element-before", []ByteEdit{{n.ms, 0, ins(key + el[0] + ",")}}},
	}
	if !strings.Contains(key, `\`) && strings.ToUpper(key) != key {
		out = append(out, objCase{"dup-bare-first-element-after-upper", []ByteEdit{{n.ve, 0, ins("," + strings.ToUpper(key) + el[0])}}})
	}
	if len(el) > 1 {
		last := el[len(el)-1]
		out = append(out,
			objCase{"dup-bare-last-element-after", []ByteEdit{{n.ve, 0, ins("," + key + last)}}},
			objCase{"dup-bare-last-element-before", []ByteEdit{{n.ms, 0, ins(key + last + ",")}}})
	}
	return out
}

func dupBareCorpus(fixtures, out string) error {
	f := &ByteFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-bytes-corpus/v1",
		Description: "Every list member of every object path class of the bases (the first sweepK documents of each form holding the class; the genesis-link documents first), given a second occurrence of its key as a BARE element (not wrapped in a list): the list's first element or its last, written before the list and after it, and the first one after it with the key in upper case. A list of unions (encoding.JsonUnmarshalListWith) takes a bare value as a list of one written over index 0 and keeps the rest; a JsonList (a list or, failing that, a single value) replaces the list by a fresh list of one. Judged by VerifyPortable from the text."}
	gb, err := genesisBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ob, err := objBases(fixtures)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	have := map[string]bool{}
	var bases []string
	for _, b := range append(append([]string(nil), gb...), ob...) {
		if !have[b] {
			have[b] = true
			bases = append(bases, b)
		}
	}
	f.Bases = bases
	docs := make([][]byte, len(bases))
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		raw, err := baseDoc(fixtures, bpath)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", bpath, err)
		}
		docs[bi] = raw
		be, ok := judgeStableCounting(raw, new(int), new(int))
		if !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s: Go is unstable on the base document", bpath)
		}
		f.BaseExpect = append(f.BaseExpect, be)
	}
	shard, shards := 0, 1
	if v := os.Getenv("XTS_SHARD"); v != "" {
		if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(v, "%d/%d", &shard, &shards); err != nil || shards < 1 || shard < 0 || shard >= shards {
			return fmt.Errorf("XTS_SHARD %q: want i/n", v)
		}
	}
	use := map[string]int{}
	classes := map[string]bool{}
	byV := map[string]int{}
	seq := 0
	for bi, bpath := range bases {
		form := "2.1"
		if objForm20.Match(docs[bi]) {
			form = "2.0"
		}
		w := &objWalker{b: docs[bi]}
		w.value(0, "", "", -1, false)
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, n := range w.out {
			if n.class == "" {
				n.class = "$root"
			}
			if seen[n.class] {
				continue
			}
			seen[n.class] = true
			k := form + "|" + n.class
			if use[k]++; use[k] > sweepK {
				continue
			}
			for _, c := range dupBareCases(docs[bi], n) {
				if seq++; (seq-1)%shards != shard {
					continue
				}
				classes[k] = true
				if os.Getenv("XTS_COUNT") != "" {
					continue
				}
				text := applyEdits(docs[bi], c.edits)
				lastPanic, lastFlaky = "", ""
				ex, ok := judgeSweep(text, &f.Skipped.Panics, &f.Skipped.Flaky)
				if !ok {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "PANIC/FLAKY %s %s [%s] %s%s\n", bpath, n.class, c.name, lastPanic, lastFlaky)
					continue
				}
				byV[ex.V]++
				f.Cases = append(f.Cases, ByteCase{ID: fmt.Sprintf("dupbare:%s:%s:%s", bpath, n.class, c.name), Base: bi, Op: "dupbare " + c.name, Edits: c.edits, Expect: ex})
			}
		}
	}
	var names []string
	for k, v := range byV {
		names = append(names, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%d", k, v))
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dupbare shard %d/%d: %d bases, %d path classes (form|class), %d cases in all, %d judged here (%s)\n", shard, shards, len(bases), len(classes), seq, len(f.Cases), strings.Join(names, " "))
	if os.Getenv("XTS_COUNT") != "" {
		return nil
	}
	return writeGz(filepath.Join(out, fmt.Sprintf("bytes-cases-dupbare-%d.json.gz", shard)), mustJSON(f))
}
